library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(gghighlight)


top10_cities <- cities %>%
  arrange(desc(population)) %>%
  slice(1:10)


conus_bbox <- st_bbox(states)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = countries, fill = "gray90", color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = top10_cities, aes(size = population), color = "red") +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = top10_cities,
    aes(label = city, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(conus_bbox$xmin, conus_bbox$xmax),
           ylim = c(conus_bbox$ymin, conus_bbox$ymax),
           expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Most Populous Cities in the USA",
       subtitle = "Zoomed on the Contiguous U.S.") +
  theme_minimal()








#3.2

us_border <- states %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

cities <- cities %>%
  mutate(dist_border_km = drop_units(set_units(
    st_distance(geometry, us_border), "km")))


farthest_border <- cities %>%
  slice_max(dist_border_km, n = 5)

  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "gray60") +

  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Distance (km)") +
  geom_sf(data = farthest_border, color = "black", size = 2) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = farthest_border,
    aes(label = city, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(conus_bbox$xmin, conus_bbox$xmax),
           ylim = c(conus_bbox$ymin, conus_bbox$ymax),
           expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "USA Cities by Distance to National Border",
       subtitle = "Top 5 Cities Farthest from a National Border") +
  theme_minimal()

cities <- cities %>%
  mutate(in_danger_zone = dist_border_km <= 160)


border_zone_stats <- cities %>%
  summarize(
    total_cities = n(),
    cities_in_zone = sum(in_danger_zone),
    pct_cities_in_zone = round((cities_in_zone / total_cities) * 100, 2),
    total_population = sum(population, na.rm = TRUE),
    population_in_zone = sum(population[in_danger_zone], na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_population_in_zone = round((population_in_zone / total_population) * 100, 2)
  )

border_zone_stats %>% flextable()
